headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP revenue across Subscription (Self-Managed + SaaS) and License & Other.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): GitLab delivered $286.25M in Q2 FY27 (+21.3% YoY). Management guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $281M–$283M (~15%–16% YoY), while Street Yahoo 0q consensus sits at $282.81M and buy-side whispers look for $290M–$295M+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share excluding $75.01M stock-based compensation.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS ($/sh): Consensus is $0.20/sh (matching Q3 guidance high end of $0.19–$0.20 vs $0.24 in Q2 FY27 and $0.25 in Q3 FY26). GitLab has beaten consensus EPS 4 straight quarters by an average of +24.98%.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Paid Consumption Run Rate (Duo AI & Flex)
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Annualized Paid Consumption Run Rate (CRR) across GitLab Duo Agent Platform and hybrid Flex usage.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Paid CRR ($M): Surged >$40M exiting Q2 FY27 (up sharply from $15M in Q1 FY27), propelled by ~50% QoQ Duo Agent Platform expansion and 130+ Flex customers committing >$20M in six weeks.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate (DBNRR) & Ultimate Mix
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Trailing 12-month net expansion rate across existing cohorts and Ultimate tier share of ARR.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: DBNRR & Ultimate Tier: DBNRR accelerated sequentially to 117% in Q2 FY27 while Ultimate grew ~35% YoY to reach 59% of total ARR. Sustaining DBNRR >= 117% proves seat expansion + AI upsells offset macro headwinds.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: SaaS Revenue Mix & Net ARR Growth (%)
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Cloud-hosted GitLab SaaS share of total revenue and Net New ARR growth rate.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: SaaS & Net ARR: SaaS climbed +36% YoY to reach 34% of total revenue in Q2 FY27 while Net ARR grew >40% YoY (~42%). Investors track SaaS durability alongside Flex accounting timing ($13M potential FY27 rev-rec shift).
